Name: Chests Anywhere
Author: Pathoschild
TagLine: Access your chests, dressers, fridge, shipping bin, and Junimo huts from anywhere and organise them your way. Transfer items without having to run around, from the comfort of your bed to the deepest mine level. Includes optional balanced mode.
Description:
Access your chests, dressers, fridge, shipping bin, and Junimo huts from anywhere by pressing `B`. Transfer items without having to run around, from the comfort of your bed to the deepest mine level.

![](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Pathoschild/StardewMods/stable/ChestsAnywhere/docs/screenshots/animated-usage.gif)

Translated into Chinese, English, French, German, Hungarian, Italian, Japanese, Korean, Portuguese, Russian, Spanish, and Turkish ([translations welcome](https://github.com/Pathoschild/StardewMods#translating-the-mods)).

![](https://i.imgur.com/suHzq2E.png)
1. [Install the latest version of SMAPI](https://smapi.io).
2. Install the mod through ModDrop (or unzip the download into `Stardew Valley/Mods`).
3. Run the game using SMAPI.

_Optional:_ by default you can access all your chests from anywhere. You can enable **balanced mode**, which only lets you access chests in your current world area and disables remote access in the mines. See the [optional file on Nexus](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/518?tab=files) or [manually edit the `config.json`](https://github.com/Pathoschild/StardewMods/tree/develop/ChestsAnywhere#configure) to enable it.

![](https://i.imgur.com/M7KlO44.png)
* Compatible with...
  * Stardew Valley 1.5 or later;
  * Linux, macOS, or Windows;
  * single-player or multiplayer (even if other players don't have it, but see below).

**Known issues in multiplayer:**
* Farmhands only see chests in synced locations (mainly the farm, farmhouse, constructed farm buildings, and their current location). This is due to limitations in the way the game's multiplayer works.

**Mod conflicts:**
* Joys of Efficiency may cause errors when opening the shipping bin.

![](https://i.imgur.com/j6fpZ3A.png)
* **Access chests** by pressing `B`. This will show your chests grouped by category. Navigate by clicking the top dropdowns, or by pressing the arrow keys.
* **Edit chests** by clicking the edit icon after opening a chest ([see example](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Pathoschild/StardewMods/stable/ChestsAnywhere/docs/screenshots/animated-edit.gif)). This will show a form where you can...
  * set the chest name;
  * set a category (which defaults to its location);
  * set the sort order in the chest list;
  * or hide the chest from the chest list.
* **Point at a chest** in the world to see its name in a tooltip (if it has one).
* **Open the shipping bin** as if it were a chest to take items back out before they're shipped.

You can optionally [customise the mod settings](https://github.com/Pathoschild/StardewMods/tree/stable/ChestsAnywhere#configuration) (including keyboard/controller mappings).

![](https://i.imgur.com/ccJ4SPZ.png)
